article.title: Using iPads to crack down on market-clearing prices
article.excerpt: The local government in the popular coastal resort of Sanya in southern China’s Hainan province has decided to introduce a centralized digital food ordering system to prevent the city’s seafood restaurants from overpricing. Seafood restaurants with 15 or more tables will be required to use iPads to process their orders, Southern Metropolis Daily reported on
